Gold.note: Strong momentum and safe-haven demand amid macro uncertainty.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and precious metal demand driving strong price momentum.

Copper.note: Tight concentrates and robust green energy transition demand support upside.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity additions.

Lithium.note: Oversupply concerns and EV demand growth normalization weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surplus and weak stainless steel demand pressure prices.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge squeezes and mine supply constraints.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets steady steel production.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand softening as gas prices normalize and renewables grow.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls and subdued EV motor demand create market uncertainty.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand balanced by ample South African supply.

PGM.note: Sluggish global auto production and ample South African mine supply.

Potash.note: Stable agricultural demand balanced by returning Belarus and Russian exports.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong lightweighting demand in autos.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure to copper and iron ore provides balanced macro risk.
